_doc: Registered camera-pose assumptions for Q16 (one entry per photograph view). Nothing here is a measured 1863 camera position: every position, heading and focal length is an ASSUMPTION with its basis and tier. position: anchor = gazetteer place (app/data/gazetteer.json, tier inferred, sigma_m shown), snap = optional rule applied on the modern DEM (summit = highest DEM cell within snap_r_m of the anchor), offset_m = [east, north] metres. heading: toward = bearing from the camera to a gazetteer place; or fixed deg. fov_h_deg: the focal length is NOT documented in any source read; 40 deg horizontal is a generic view-camera assumption (plausible-procedural), the report states the effect of +-10 deg. agl_m: camera height above DEM, 1.6 m (tripod, assumption). The DEM is modern bare ground, not 1863 land cover (no trees, crops, 1863 contour corrections).

_crop_note: photo_crop_1600 = print area inside the plate border, [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the 1600-px working copy, set by eye. photo_horizon_frac = horizon row / crop height, read by eye from the working copy (about +-0.02).
